newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 165,000 T U.S. or Australia wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 165,000 T U.S. or Australia wheat.

text.p: Egypt's government-owned Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said on Monday it bought 165,000 tonnes of American hard red winter wheat or Australian hard red wheat for delivery in June and July.
An official told Reuters the shipments were as follows:
-- Tradigrain would supply 55,000 tonnes, plus or minus ten percent, of U.S. or Australian wheat, seller's option, for delivery 15 to 25 June at a price of $175.73 c and f.
-- Amiga grain would supply 55,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat, sellers option, delivery 1 to 10 July for $172.95 c and f.
-- Souflet would supply 55,000 tonnes, plus or minus ten percent, of U.S. hard red winter wheat for delivery 15 to 25 July for $171.5 c and f.
